title: Add deterministic test scenario runner
problem: Kajiya Build Line can now store schema-validated test scenario artifacts, but it cannot execute them deterministically yet. This means humans/chats can design QA contracts, but QA still cannot run those contracts automatically.
expected_behavior: A deterministic run-scenario command reads a docs/test-scenarios/*.json artifact, executes its setup, writes input files, runs commands, evaluates simple assertions, and returns JSON-compatible pass/fail output without modifying the main repository state.
proposed_change: Add CLI command: kajiya-build-line run-scenario --scenario FILE.
Support test scenarios with setup_commands, input_files, commands, assertions, and cleanup_policy.
Execute scenarios inside a temporary working directory when setup uses TMP_REPO.
Capture command stdout, stderr, and returncode.
Evaluate assertion types: equals and contains.
Support JSON path assertions for simple paths like $.ok, $.runtime_status, $.active_issue_id, and $.items.length.
Return JSON-compatible output with scenario_id, ok, command_results, assertion_results, and next_safe_actions.
Do not integrate run-scenario into qa yet.
Do not implement Builder retry or repair loops yet.
close_criteria: Command writes input_files into the scenario working directory.
Main repo state is not modified by running the scenario.
